name: Gold Dust
summary: In Elwynn Forest, kobolds gather and hoard flecks of gold in the mines. Local buyers pay for the dust, while miners seek whole veins of ore.

sections.title: A Pouch Full of Scraps
sections.body: Kobolds dig through the Fargodeep and Jasperlode mines beneath Elwynn Forest. They keep the gold dust they find in pockets and pouches instead of refining it. Local peddlers and fences want these scraps, hoping to profit without paying official smelting tariffs.

sections.title: Goldshire's Black Market
sections.body: In Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" asks travelers to bring him recovered gold dust. He says he offers the best price in town, trading coin and suspicious tokens for raw dust on behalf of unnamed associates. Travelers retrieve the gold from kobolds, while the brokers secure wealth beneath the noses of the Stormwind guards.

faq.q: Where does Gold Dust come from?
faq.answer: Kobolds throughout Elwynn Forest carry Gold Dust. Miners, tunnelers, geomancers, and their leader Goldtooth gather and hoard it as they dig through the hills.

faq.q: Which mines hold the most kobolds carrying Gold Dust?
faq.answer: Kobolds carrying dust overrun both Fargodeep Mine, south of Goldshire, and Jasperlode Mine, to the northeast.

faq.q: Who buys Gold Dust in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Remy "Two Times," a shady dealer outside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, buys collected pouches of Gold Dust for money and tokens from his associates.

faq.q: Why do kobolds carry dust instead of ingots?
faq.answer: Kobolds lack the discipline and infrastructure to smelt ore properly. As they dig through the rock with crude pickaxes, loose gold dust gathers on their belongings and in small pouches they carry as shiny trinkets.

angles.text: Miners seek solid veins of copper and tin with pick and pan. Kobold dust suggests Elwynn's underground passages hold richer lodes than standard surveys reveal.
As a rogue, you can learn how the underworld moves unrefined, untracked dust through shady dealers like Remy "Two Times," hiding raw wealth from Stormwind's magistrates.
